notes.title: Introduction
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I just wanted to share some basic information about me, my development process and the game.

[h2]About me[/h2]
My name is Peter Jurkovsky and I am from eastern Slovakia (Prešov). I am a solo indie game developer who develops games in Unity from 2015 in my spare time besides fulltime job, wife, one child and other hobbies. And this is my desk where all the work is being done:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43738842/7b133a40df02fe21c3f57c5ea629776f46aa2369.jpg[/img]

[h2]My previous games[/h2]
From 2015 I have released three smaller mobile games and one PC game called Juro Janosik, which was released in 2021. For my surprise, with this game I have managed to win the Best Game Award in Game Access '22 conference in Brno, Czech Republic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43738842/d7998b3ab434534d7159dba71cd6905282fb3a29.jpg[/img]

If you want to support me you can buy the game or add it to your wishlist. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/978630/Juro_Janosik/

[h2]Current project[/h2]
[b]Wendigo Hunter[/b] is my current project I am working on. I started working on it in January 2022 and I think it's now somewhere between prototype and vertical slice phase. So there is still a lot of work to be done. My plan is to have a playable demo in Q4 2024 and then release the game as Early Access (hopefully in the end of 2024).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43738842/a624725150e70da70dea3f1ff8074436ff31d853.jpg[/img]

There is an Arts Council in Slovakia which annually choose few game projects and support them with funding. So this year I have participated in such "competiton" and in few weeks there should be a resolution. So keep your fingers crossed :)

Thank you, stay tuned and have a nice day.

P.S. I hope you have already added Wendigo Hunter to your wishlist. If not, you know what to do :D
